status: PHS 231 is under construction: eighteen of 22 lessons are available. No major course is complete.

delivered.plan: Full proposed coverage plan for 22 lessons across nine modules, assessments, project, resources, dependencies, and release gates.
investigations: One-dimensional motion, reversals, and signed graph areas
Projectile flights, apex states, and admissible contact times
External force inventories, normal constraints, and contact loss
Static thresholds, relative sliding, and loss of friction capacity
Linear-drag transients, time constants, upward launches, and the zero-drag limit
Circular vector components, signed tangential acceleration, actual force inventories, and infeasible track contact
Exterior circular-orbit comparisons with inverse-square fields, mass and source scaling, energy references, and explicit transfer limitations
Signed work and kinetic-energy curves, with finite turns, inaccessible energy barriers, asymptotic equilibrium, exact rest, and instantaneous power
Attached-spring ramp energy ledgers with kinetic friction, reference shifts, first-stop limits, and actual versus untraveled dissipation
Three-dimensional external force pulses, signed impulse histories, CM displacement timing, fixed-shape peak scaling, and zero-impulse limitations
Smooth oblique collision and common-velocity sticking comparisons, passive restitution, rotated contact normals, non-approach gating, and lab/CM velocity diagrams with momentum and energy ledgers
Fixed-axis rotor with independent mass radii and drive leverage, signed torque inventory, full point acceleration, reversal travel, keyboard snapshots, and separate configuration comparisons

Changing-radius disk and masses with conserved angular momentum or motor-controlled speed, separate motor/radial work, transient radial kinetic energy, body-frame geometry, and complete keyboard-accessible time tables

Coupled rolling and sliding with required versus available static friction, exact catch and reverse-slip events, independent translation/spin, marked material-point motion, signed power and heat, and complete keyboard-accessible histories

Static beam reactions with unilateral contacts, local friction, distributed loads, raised forces and couples, exact moving-load windows, independent-origin residuals, and complete keyboard-accessible force and sweep tables
